profile_text.body:
Stability AI is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in London, UK. Its website is presented through Clipdrop, an image editing suite that the company describes as enabling users to remove backgrounds, clean up pictures, upscale images, and run Stable Diffusion-based generation. Clipdrop was co-founded in 2020 by Cyril Diagne, who served as CEO, Jonathan Blanchet, who served as CTO, and Damien Henry, who served as COO, before being acquired by Stability AI in 2023.

Stability AI's tracked products include Clipdrop, described as an image editing AI suite with commercial licensing built within the Stability AI ecosystem, and Stable Diffusion, an open-weight image generation model. Stable Diffusion is among the most widely recognized open-weight generative image models, and Clipdrop serves as a consumer-facing interface for related tools.

The company is a defendant or named party in five recorded legal cases. Getty Images has filed suits in both the District of Delaware and the Northern District of California. Additional cases include Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. and Anders v. Stability AI US Services Corporation, both copyright-related actions, as well as EVOX Productions LLC v. Stability AI, Inc., filed in the Central District of California.
